beforeBuyInfo.title: What you need to know before acquiring a cheat?
beforeBuyInfo.description:
Let me explain right away! Why do the majority of players buy cheats?!

Earn money by helping others achieve goals or complete missions, use specific cheats (Aim, Wallhack, Avto shot) to "understand the zen" (try what a cheat is), avoid constant losses or just have fun.

But remember, by acquiring a cheat, you yourself have chosen to side with pleasure ;)
